title: Carnot Meets Quantum Information: A Thermal Machine Driven by Non-orthogonal State Discrimination
summary: While the impossibility of perfectly identifying non-orthogonal states is a cornerstone of quantum information science, they can nevertheless be distinguished with a finite error probability. Here, we propose a two-reservoir quantum machine driven by such non-orthogonal-state discrimination to map its functional boundaries across the parameter space of the state overlap $μ$ and the Carnot efficiency $η_C$.
